A note from the Singh family

A heartfelt invitation

With hearts filled with joy and gratitude, the Singh family warmly invites you to celebrate the beautiful union of Priya and Abhishek.

As two hearts come together to begin a wonderful new journey, we would be truly honoured to have your presence and blessings on this special occasion.

Join us for a celebration filled with love, laughter, cherished traditions, and unforgettable memories. Your presence will make our happiness complete and this auspicious occasion even more meaningful.

We look forward to celebrating these precious moments with you and your family.

With love and warm regards,

The Singh Family
